sections.h2: Picking up your car at Orlando Airport
sections.html: Many of the big brands have rental counters inside the terminal at Orlando International, with cars in the parking garages, and Terminal C has its own rental car area. Some brands are off-airport and use a shuttle. Your booking confirmation says which terminal and counter to go to.

Central Florida has lots of toll roads, including routes from the airport towards the theme parks and the coast. Rental companies offer toll programmes that charge you for tolls used, usually with a daily or per-rental fee. Read how your company’s programme is charged before you drive off, as costs vary a lot.

• Orlando is one of the busiest rental markets in the world: book early for school holidays.
  • Compare minivans and full-size SUVs if you’re a family with lots of luggage.
  • Theme parks charge for parking, so factor that into your budget.
  • Kennedy Space Center and the Atlantic beaches are an easy day trip east of Orlando.

faqs.q: Do I need a toll pass for an Orlando rental car?
faqs.a: You can’t easily avoid toll roads around Orlando, so most drivers use the rental company’s toll programme. Check its fees before you collect the car.
